packageRules.description: Only update uv.lock for Python packages
Disable lock file maintenance on uv.lock for post-release branches.

description: No per-dependency pep621 PRs: the manager only sees direct dependencies, so it can't react to a
audits uv.lock daily and files those instead; everything else rides the weekly lock file maintenance.
Note this disables update types rather than the manager, which would take lockFileMaintenance with it.
